status: Development design after inspected v1-v16a; frozen before this trial's outer predictions. Not preregistration or independent confirmation.
anchor: Existing fixed T for Binder/Wielek and original uHNDI for Mendeley. All comparisons keep both baselines; this assignment itself is not supplementary-information gain.

binder.features: At each released aggregate ITPC time point, 32 channel/band response-to-own-baseline contrasts (ITPC-baseline)/(ITPC+baseline). Pair time points10samples apart on the same release grid. Patient-balanced mean and second raw moment of the concatenated pairs. Half-open time/frequency intervals. Common spacing .009765625s, lag .09765625s; overlapping500ms ITPC windows, not independent trials or physiological fine-latency measurements.
binder.reference: All20 released opt5 healthy controls, same8channels/features and pairing. Check anonymous ID sets disjoint from patients. Healthy reference supplies only unlabeled geometry/covariance targets; no HC diagnosis enters binary training labels. without_healthy ablation uses training-patient moments instead; never add healthy people to clinical ROC.

wielek.features: Full5x5 automatic-stage joint proportions from valid consecutive epochs within same time_record. Each patient's legal pair matrix normalized to sum1; equal patient weights within each class. No manual stage, eyes, demographics, timing values as classifier fields or healthy sequence fabricated.

mendeley.features: Original4s six-channel mean PSD density cache. Multiply by band widths, normalize per block, take square-root five-band relative power. Pair only clean consecutive original blocks, no bridge across discarded artifacts. Patient-balanced8D joint moments after a learned4D projection. No raw EEG front-end change or patient exclusion; fixed-QC common power gain cancels in extras, not in the full method containing absoluteT.

reference_geometry: Continuous cohorts: pool equal-patient single endpoint moments in available healthy reference (Binder) or training patients (Mendeley/nohealthyBinder). Learn top4 covariance eigenvectors, divide by sqrt(eigenvalue+.01trace/d). Center using reference mean. Transform patient joint moments analytically. No query patient contributes to learned geometry. Categorical Wielek uses all5states directly.
density: Continuous: fit patient-balanced per-class joint Gaussian and single endpoint Gaussian; covariance .5class+.5reference+.01trace(reference)/dimension times identity. Eigenvalue floor comes from reference scale, no data-unit absolute epsilon. Wielek joint probability=.5class+.5reference plus .001uniform, renormalized; single marginal is average of left/right class joint marginal. No clinical class prior odds term.
evidence: Two fields: marginal logdensity MCS-minus-VS summed over both endpoints; interaction=(joint MCS-minus-VS)-marginal. Gaussian expected log density computed exactly from patient mean/second moment; categorical from full joint proportions. These two fields sum to joint evidence, not independent measurements. They are statistical density summaries, not causal/directed neural mechanisms or independent-sample likelihood significance.
crossfit: For each training patient's representation, remove that entire patient from reference geometry and both class densities, then compute its evidence. Binder healthy geometry is independently fixed but class densities still exclude the patient. Heldout queries use only full training reference. Record all leave-patient-out reference memberships. Training feature rows share other patients/labels and are not independent validation rows. Cache each split's upstream extraction identically for all downstream models.
calibration: Train-only robust asinh two anchors. Use training leave-patient-out evidence medians/IQR(std/1 fallback), tanh, least-squares projection on[1,aT,aU], then tanh residual. Fit convex all positive-negative patient pair logistic loss plus .1/2||beta||^2, coefficient bounds[-eta/p,+eta/p]. Hence total prediction correction <=eta. No test-label sign choice.
optimizer: Analytic-gradient L-BFGS-B with maxiter500,maxls100,gtol1e-8,ftol1e-12. Accept only projected-gradient KKT<=1e-6 and finite objective/parameters; otherwise technical stop. eta0 is exact zero correction.
controls: Marginal/interaction use respective evidence column. Nohealthy removes only Binder healthy source. Shuffled pairs permute second endpoints within each valid contiguous segment and preserve both endpoint marginals; not actual physiological links. Anchor-only correction has two tanh nonlinear functions of training-normalized old anchors, no signal evidence. Standalone joint/marginal evidence uses full training density without output anchor. Same-input classifiers use two normalized anchors plus exactly the two leave-patient-out training/full-train query evidence fields (tanh scaled, no anchor residualization). Signal information, healthy reference and supervised upstream fit are identical across main/comparators. Quality-only gets four original v10 support/retention values and no evidence.

etmc.views: anchors2,marginal1,interaction1 and concatenated pseudo-view; vector adaptation, not original image backbone

roboss.implementation: Paper loss/Gaussian kernel, deterministic L-BFGS adaptation, not original NAG

splits: Exactly existing v10 roles, separate cohorts. No heldout patient signal or label enters any population fit, density, scaler, projection, calibration or inner selection. All45/23/41patients retained.
selection: Mean3inner-fold AUC, tie1e-12 takes earlier candidate; eta0 first. Upstream reference/density hyperparameters fixed, not selected on outcomes.
metric: Arithmetic mean outer-fold AUC, then5seedmean, then equal-cohortmacro; no pooled calibrated OOF headline.
performance_target: Everyseedmacro positive delta versus T and originaluHNDI; everycohort5seedmean positive versus both; positive mean macro versus measurement_anchor,anchor_only_increment,marginal_only_increment and shuffled_pair_increment. Report nohealthy/interaction ablations and all same-input recent comparisons; no superiority claim without supporting comparisons and independent confirmation.
novelty_limit: Candidate combination of patient-balanced paired-signal density references, independent healthy geometry where available, patient-excluded evidence calibration and bounded anchor correction. No constituent priority, guaranteed gain, physical gain invariance of full model, clinical mechanism or unseen-center validation claim.
protection: Freeze scientific code/protocol before outer predictions; guard output overwrite; retain all completed histories/manuscripts, dependencies, exact moment/evidence floats, split roles and technical failures. No outcome-informed rewriting.
